reading.body:
Digital Fortress: Richmond is a colocation facility in Chesterfield County, Virginia. No power capacity, rack count, cooling specification, or other IT infrastructure figure is published by the operator. The facility's own specification page on the operator's website returns a 404 error. Without published power or density data, this campus cannot be assessed for AI scaling relevance.

Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities, of which 23 publish power capacity totaling 1,375 megawatts. This facility is ranked 24th by published capacity among those sites, placing it below the state's published baseline and indicating no disclosed power figure.

The operator's own homepage confirms a Richmond location and accepts quote requests but does not disclose specifications for this site. Any assessment of this campus's role in AI infrastructure would require the operator to publish power capacity, IT load, or cooling specifications, which are not currently available.
